name: AK28A - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), 4-Button Control, Twin-Dial Display
highlights: Four Buttons Instead of a Menu — Clock, alert, brightness and power each get their own key on the front. No double-tapping, no press-and-hold, no learning which combination does what.
Wedge Stand, Fixed Viewing Angle — The moulded rear wedge sets the screen back at a reading angle without a fold-out leg to snap off — the version to specify for a desk that gets knocked.
Twin-Dial Face — Particulates in one ring, gases in the other, climate and clock between them, with a six-step AQI scale beneath.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour USB-C charge, 230 g — the lightest of the large-screen desktop models.
32 Per Carton — Same carton spec as AK23 despite the different body, so the two platforms mix freely on a pallet.
